name: obsidian-vault
description: Five skills that treat an Obsidian vault as a knowledge graph rather than a folder of files. Search the vault with priority-aware ranking and subagent synthesis, discover and apply bidirectional wikilinks, summarize a research paper with cropped figures and honest vault placement, snapshot folder activity into folder notes, and write a daily log from Claude Code sessions, git commits, and vault changes. Use when the user searches or asks what they know about a topic, wants notes connected or linked, wants a paper summarized, wants vault state documented, or wants a daily or end-of-day log.
